**ABOUT ME** 

**As an EDM artist, I'm inspired by my fans to think constantly about the future landscape of electronic music and where I fit in. By staying involved with the festival circuit and maintaining an active presence on social media, I'm able to create organically for me and my fans which helps me foster a genuine creator-listener relationship.**
